description.zh: 结束时间。只对无需在GuestOS内执行云助手指令的诊断指标生效。
description.en: The end time. This parameter applies only to diagnostic metrics that do not require running Cloud Assistant commands in the guest OS.

description.zh: 诊断指标集合ID。如果为空，则会使用ECS实例的默认诊断指标集合dms-instancedefault。
description.en: The diagnostic metric set ID. If this parameter is omitted, the default diagnostic metric set for ECS instances, `dms-instancedefault`, is used.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to get the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh: 开始时间。只对无需在GuestOS内执行云助手指令的诊断指标生效。
description.en: The start time. This parameter applies only to diagnostic metrics that do not require running Cloud Assistant commands in the guest OS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-diagnostic-report --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --metric-set-id dms-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --start-time 2022-07-11T12:00Z --end-time 2022-07-11T14:00Z --additional-options key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
